decision: Close the existing total-width-384 compact-attention output topology. Even direct coefficients miss residual energy and final RMSE, while the realizable compact attention is substantially worse than this oracle. Authorize a source-aligned attention-head subset architecture review and one train-only contribution-statistics oracle that derives the minimum exact source-head subset meeting 0.98 attention-delta reconstruction and evaluates that single subset held out. Do not sweep head counts or retain a complete source block.
claim_boundary: Negative read-only rank-384 attention-output-span evidence only; no realizable attention, source-block retention, model, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
